text: Speak Your Mind is the debut studio album by English singer Anne-Marie, released on 27 April 2018, through Major Tom's, Asylum Records, and Atlantic Records. Anne-Marie announced the album, described as a pop and EDM record, on 21 February 2018, and it became available for pre-order two days later. The album was recorded from 2015 to 2018 at various studios, with production handled by Jennifer Decilveo, Nick Monson, Amir Amor, Chris Loco, Marshmello, The Invisible Men, MNEK, TMS, Teddy Geiger, Fred Ball, Fraser T. Smith, Jack Patterson of Clean Bandit, Mark Ralph, David Guetta, and Steve Mac, among others. Marshmello makes a guest appearance and is the sole guest on the standard track listing, while Clean Bandit and David Guetta, along with Sean Paul, appear on various reissues. The album was supported by seven singles: "Alarm," "Ciao Adios," "Heavy," "Then," "Friends" (featuring Marshmello), "2002," and "Perfect to Me," a remix of "Perfect." "Alarm," released on 20 May 2016, charted at number 16 on the UK Singles Chart and number 7 on the ARIA Charts in Australia, where it was certified 2× Platinum, and reached number 3 on the Billboard Bubbling Under Hot 100. "Ciao Adios," released on 10 February 2017, peaked at number 9 in the UK and was certified 2× Platinum in the UK and Netherlands, with Platinum in Australia, Germany, and Poland, and Gold in Canada. "Heavy" and "Then" had modest success in the UK, with "Then" reaching number 87 in the UK and certifying Silver by the BPI. "Friends," released on 9 February 2018, became Anne-Marie's first entry on the Billboard Hot 100, peaking at number 11, and was certified 6× Platinum in Canada, 4× Platinum in the US and Australia, and 3× Platinum in the UK. "2002," released on 20 April 2018, debuted at number 8 in the UK and climbed to number 3, becoming Anne-Marie's highest-charting solo single there, and was certified 8× Platinum in the US, 5× Platinum in Canada, and 4× Platinum in the UK. "Perfect to Me," released on 2 November 2018, reached number 57 in the UK and was certified Gold. A stripped version of "Peak," released on 21 October 2016, became the main version of the song and was included as a bonus track on the Japan and digital deluxe editions. "Can I Get Your Number" and "Trigger" also charted, with "Trigger" peaking at number 59 on the Irish Singles Chart. The album received generally favorable reviews, with a Metacritic score of 62 based on eight reviews, indicating "generally favorable reviews." It peaked at number 3 on the UK Albums (OCC) and Scottish Albums (OCC) charts, number 4 on the Irish Albums (IRMA) chart, and number 31 on the Billboard Hot 100. It was certified Platinum by the BPI (300,000 units), Platinum by the RIAA (1,000,000 units), and 2× Platinum by Music Canada (160,000 units). The album was reissued with bonus tracks, including the chart-topping "Rockabye" (Clean Bandit featuring Sean Paul and Anne-Marie) and the modestly successful "Don't Leave Me Alone" (David Guetta featuring Anne-Marie). Anne-Marie promoted the album with the Speak Your Mind Tour from 2018 to 2019, featuring supporting acts such as Lennon Stella and Goody Grace. Speaking to Luvpop, Anne-Marie explained that the title reflects her honesty and openness, stating she "doesn't hold anything in" and "speak[s] my mind a lot." The album charted in numerous countries, including number 18 in Australia, number 16 in Canada, number 10 in Switzerland, number 66 in France (certified Gold), number 24 in Germany, number 4 in Ireland, number 9 in the Czech Republic, number 11 in Finland, number 78 in Italy, number 17 in the Netherlands, number 33 in Sweden, number 27 in Spain, number 31 in New Zealand, number 16 in Austria, number 3 in Scotland, number 50 in Portugal, number 9 in Slovakia, and number 185 in Japan. In South Korea, it charted at number 3 on the Circle Music Chart. The album was certified Gold in Norway (60,000 units) and Singapore (5,000 units), and reached number 3 in Scotland. The digital deluxe edition later included "Don't Leave Me Alone." "Rockabye," originally released on 21 October 2016, topped charts in the UK, Australia, Austria, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Sweden, and Switzerland, and reached number 4 in Canada and number 9 on the Billboard Hot 100, with certifications including 7× Platinum in Canada and Italy, 5× Platinum in Australia, 4× Platinum in the UK, 3× Platinum in the US, and 2× Platinum in Germany and Switzerland. "Don't Leave Me Alone," released on 27 July 2018, charted at number 18 in the UK and reached number 2 on the Ultratop Belgium Dance chart, and was certified Platinum in Australia, Canada, and Poland. The tour began on 20 August 2018 in Los Angeles and concluded on 19 June 2019 in London, with supporting acts including Goody Grace, Mahalia, Kojey Radical, Ella Watson, Cellarr (then known as "OpenSide"), Glades, and Lennon Stella. The setlist from the O2 Academy in Leeds may not represent all tour performances. Sales figures are based on certification alone, and streaming is included in certification.
